properties.summary: PostgreSQL source of truth with a Redis Streams dispatch relay for lower latency.
properties.reason: PostgreSQL remains the acceptance barrier; Redis Streams only carry dispatch notifications derived from a transactional outbox.
properties.orderingNote: PostgreSQL claim ordering preserved; Redis stream is a wake-up notification, not the ordering authority.
properties.delayedRetryStrategy: native run_at query with Redis wake-up
properties.failureRecovery: loss of Redis is recoverable by replaying unacknowledged outbox rows; no dual write.

acknowledgementBarrier.reason: Ingest, ledger, payload, and dispatch job commit in one transaction.

durableProtocolV1Acknowledgement.reason: 202 is returned only after the four artifacts are durable.

restartRecovery.reason: PostgreSQL recovers fully; the Redis stream is rebuilt by replaying unpublished outbox rows.

durableIdempotency.reason: Idempotency ledger is durable for the full retry horizon.

leaseFencing.reason: Database-clock leases with fencing tokens prevent stale settlement.

multiReplicaSafe.reason: SKIP LOCKED claims allow multiple API/worker replicas.

replayRedrive.reason: Dead jobs are surfaced and redriven by explicit operator action.

requirements.backupRequirement: PostgreSQL physical or logical backup of the cell database.
